title: Acoustic analysis of anatomical phenotypes of snoring and upper airway obstruction during natural sleep compared to drug-induced sleep endoscopy
summary:
The first treatment for sleep apnea is usually positive airway pressure therapy with a sleep mask. Many patients cannot tolerate or do not want this treatment. To find alternatives, two measurements are taken: one in a sleep laboratory (polysomnography = PSG) and one during a video examination under sedation, known as drug-induced sleep endoscopy (DISE). This can be exhausting for patients.
•In this study, a new procedure is to be used in addition to the sleep laboratory examination and DISE. This procedure involves recording snoring sounds during natural sleep using a smartphone app. This app is called Somnofox. The manufacturer of the program is Diametos GmbH, based in Potsdam.
• Somnofox uses the sounds of snoring to detect where they originate in the throat. Somnofox is based on patented artificial intelligence (AI) technology.
• The aim of the study is to see whether the same
origins of snoring are found in MISE under the influence of medication as in natural sleep.

interventions.name:
Study participants will be recruited as part of clinical routine during the duration of the study. Patients with suspected or confirmed OSA who are to undergo polysomnography and drug-induced sleep endoscopy (=DISE) will be informed of the opportunity to participate in the study.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- >18 years of age
- Diagnosed OSA with a history of snoring
- Indication for polysomnography and DISE examination for further therapy recommendation
Exclusion criteria:
- <18 years
- Lack of willingness or contraindication for conducting a MISE
- Lack of willingness to participate in the study
- Insomnia
- Hypersomnia
- Parasomnia
- Acute infection
- Shift work during the study period 
- Other conditions or behaviors that, at the discretion of the study physicians, preclude participation
